checks: Creating a duplicate uses the right-click action, keeps the source/active editor and copies the custom display style
Moving via a directory modal updates the open tab and tree; right-click undo restores the original path and appearance
Copy to a typed new directory preserves the original; a local write failure retains the input and retries only unfinished items
Cut/paste from folder context opens the correct destination modal and clears completed move clipboard entries
Editor Delete never deletes selected files; recycle removes the selected file, closes its tab and restores it through the dialog without deleting display metadata
Multiple selected files share one right-click duplicate action and one native request, with both originals retained
Permanently deleting selected recycle entries uses a separate confirmation, clears their recoverable content and keeps the source note
The normal page adds no always-visible controls; right-click actions and directory modals fit all six styles at wide and narrow widths
scope: Actual App/LibraryMode/file-operation dialogs with isolated mocked IPC; actual filesystem semantics covered by Rust tests.
